versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of xiangyun-invoice-ocr skill providing OCR and verification for Chinese invoices.
- Supports full invoice processing flow: recognition, verification (for 46 invoice types), and Excel export in 5 standard templates.
- Allows single and batch (directory) processing of images/PDFs, with automatic credential verification in batch mode.
- Export templates are auto-matched by invoice type; multi-template export supported; empty result tables generated as needed.
- Step-by-step, user-driven export options: explicit user intent required to export and select template(s).
- Includes built-in error handling for API credential issues and provides user guidance for credential setup and troubleshooting.
